modules.name: ThisWorkbook
modules.source:
Private Sub Workbook_BeforeClose(Cancel As Boolean)
    CloseCount = CloseCount + 1
    Cancel = True
End Sub

modules.name: Sheet1
modules.source:
Private Sub Worksheet_Change(ByVal Target As Excel.Range)
    DocCount = DocCount + 1
    Journal = Journal & "D" & Target.Address(False, False) & ";"
    If Nested Then
        If Target.Address(False, False) = "A1" Then Target.Offset(1).Value2 = 9#
    End If
End Sub

modules.name: Watcher
modules.source:
Private WithEvents watched As Excel.Worksheet
Public Sub Connect(ByVal sh As Excel.Worksheet)
    Set watched = sh
End Sub
Public Sub Disconnect()
    Set watched = Nothing
End Sub
Private Sub watched_Change(ByVal Target As Excel.Range)
    WatchCount = WatchCount + 1
    Journal = Journal & "W" & Target.Address(False, False) & ";"
End Sub
Private Sub Class_Terminate()
    TermCount = TermCount + 1
    TermHasSource = Not (watched Is Nothing)
End Sub

modules.name: ChainOps
modules.source:
Public Function ObjectChains(ByVal ws As Object) As String
    Dim cell As Object, boxed As Variant
    ws.Range("A1").Value2 = 7#
    ws.Range("A1").Offset(1).Value = 12#
    Set cell = ws.Range("A1").Offset(1)
    Set boxed = cell
    boxed.Offset(0, 1).Value2 = boxed.Value + ws.Range("A1").Value2
    ws.Range("B3").Formula = "=A1+A2+B2"
    ObjectChains = ws.Range("A1").Offset(1).Address(False, False)
    ObjectChains = ObjectChains & ":" & ws.Range("A2").Value & ":" & boxed.Offset(0, 1).Value2
    ObjectChains = ObjectChains & ":" & ws.Range("B3").Value2
    ObjectChains = ObjectChains & ":" & (ws.Range("A1") + 2#)
    ObjectChains = ObjectChains & ":" & ws.Range("A1").Offset(RowOffset:=1).Address(False, False)
End Function
Public Function VariantChains(ByVal ws As Variant) As String
    Dim Target As Variant
    Set Target = ws.Range("D1")
    Target.Value2 = 3#
    Target.Offset(1, 0).Value2 = Target.Value2 * 4#
    ws.Cells(2, 5).Value2 = Target.Offset(1).Value2 + 2#
    VariantChains = ws.Cells(2, 5).Address(False, False) & ":" & ws.Cells(2, 5).Value2
End Function
Public Function ChainErrors(ByVal ws As Object) As String
    Dim uninitialized As Object, plain As Variant, answer As Variant
    On Error Resume Next
    answer = uninitialized.Value
    ChainErrors = Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    plain = 12
    answer = plain.Value
    ChainErrors = ChainErrors & ":" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    answer = ws.NoSuchMember
    ChainErrors = ChainErrors & ":" & Err.Number
End Function
Public Function ChainSnapshot(ByVal ws As Object) As String
    ChainSnapshot = ws.Range("A1").Value2 & ":" & ws.Range("A2").Value2
    ChainSnapshot = ChainSnapshot & ":" & ws.Range("B2").Value2 & ":" & ws.Range("B3").Value2
    ChainSnapshot = ChainSnapshot & ":" & ws.Range("D1").Value2 & ":" & ws.Range("D2").Value2 & ":" & ws.Range("E2").Value2
End Function

modules.name: WorkbookMain
modules.source:
Public Function RunProbe() As String
    Dim ws As Object
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(1)
    RunProbe = Api.RunProbe() & ";chains=" & ChainOps.ObjectChains(ws)
    RunProbe = RunProbe & ";" & ChainOps.VariantChains(ws)
    RunProbe = RunProbe & ";" & ChainOps.ChainErrors(ws) & ";" & ChainOps.ChainSnapshot(ws)
    ws.Range("A1").NumberFormat = "0.00"
    ws.Range("B2").Interior.Color = 255
    ws.Range("B2").Font.Bold = True
    ws.Range("H1").Formula = "=1/0"
End Function

modules.name: Api
modules.source:
Public Journal As String
Public DocCount As Long
Public WatchCount As Long
Public CloseCount As Long
Public TermCount As Long
Public TermHasSource As Boolean
Public Nested As Boolean
Public observer As Watcher
Public Function ResetIdle() As Long
    DocCount = 0
    Journal = ""
    Nested = False
    ResetIdle = 0
End Function
Public Function ReadIdle() As String
    ReadIdle = DocCount & ":" & Journal
End Function
Public Function Scenario(ByVal book As Excel.Workbook) As String
    Dim sh As Excel.Worksheet
    Set sh = book.Worksheets(1)
    Set observer = New Watcher
    observer.Connect sh
    DocCount = 0
    WatchCount = 0
    Journal = ""
    sh.Range("A1").Value2 = 7#
    Scenario = DocCount & ":" & WatchCount & ":" & Journal
    Nested = True
    Journal = ""
    sh.Range("A1").Value2 = 8#
    Nested = False
    Scenario = Scenario & "|nested=" & DocCount & ":" & WatchCount & ":" & Journal
    observer.Connect sh
    Journal = ""
    sh.Range("A3").Value2 = 10#
    Scenario = Scenario & "|rebind=" & WatchCount & ":" & Journal
    observer.Disconnect
    sh.Range("A4").Value2 = 11#
    observer.Connect sh
    Set observer = Nothing
    Journal = ""
    sh.Range("A5").Value2 = 12#
    Scenario = Scenario & "|release=" & WatchCount & ":" & TermCount & ":" & TermHasSource & ":" & Journal
    book.Close SaveChanges:=False
    Scenario = Scenario & "|close=" & CloseCount
End Function
Public Function RunProbe() As String
    RunProbe = Scenario(ThisWorkbook)
End Function
